senses.gloss: अचोदनम् [acōdanam], Non-injunction, a more statement (of something already known); देशकालानामचोदनं प्रयोगे नित्य- समवायात् MS.4.2.23.
अचोदस् [acōdas], a. Ved. [नास्ति चोदना यस्य] Spontaneous, not influenced by external force or compulsion. अचोदसो न धन्वन्त्विन्दवः Rv.9.79.1.
अचोविनः [acōvinḥ], (?) Probably a special messenger to report among other things, impending attacks from enemies; Sircar, SI.239 n.
